banner: EXAMPLE OUTPUT -- computed on a maintainer machine on 2026-10-04T09:48:16.492553+00:00 (v0.1.1 code, WATCH=YELLOW classification). NOT live. NOT the current flood situation. Install this repo and run floodconnect answer --at sammakorn --json yourself to get a current reading. Never quote the answer block below as current conditions.
shape_notes: Real output has exactly these top-level keys: generated_at, at, refresh, state, hazard, accountability, next_action, source_tags, cctv (cctv only when a camera exists). Each of state/hazard/accountability/next_action carries its own epistemic tag (VERIFIED/MEASURED/RELAYED/INSTINCT/OPEN). This example happens to show a YELLOW/WATCH station-level reading (a bare WATCH reading classifies as YELLOW, never RED -- RED is reserved for an agency-declared critical/overflow reading) with an open contradiction and a forecast hazard -- your own run will show whatever is true on your machine at your run time, which will differ.
